options.cmmce.filtering_mode.name: Filtering Method
options.cmmce.filtering_mode.description:
How the filter list is applied for mobs.
The CMMCE itself can also be enabled or disabled here.
Disable CMMCE for the mobs specified in the filter list.
Enable CMMCE only for mobs specified in the filter list.
options.cmmce.filtering_mode.enabled.des: Enable CMMCE for all mobs without need to change the filter list.
options.cmmce.filter_list.name: Filter List
options.cmmce.filter_list.description: Don't forget to set the filter method above to enable this!
options.cmmce.debug_box_render.name: Enable Collision Box Debugging
options.cmmce.debug_box_render.descripti: The collision box display with F3+B will show the collision box expanded by CMMCE.
options.cmmce.about.line0: Increase the size of the collision box used on interactions such as right-click and attack so that the box size visually matches to the %s models.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.cmmce: Increase the size of the collision box used on interactions such as right-click and attack so that the box size visually matches to the CMMRP models.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.cmmce: Increase collision box size to match the CMMRP models.
